items.name: Teak Dining Table 180cm
items.description: Grade A teak dining table, 180cm x 90cm, natural oil finish. Seats 6-8. Sustainably sourced Indonesian teak with mortise-and-tenon joinery. Indoor/outdoor use.

items.name: Teak Dining Table 240cm
items.description: Grade A teak dining table, 240cm x 100cm, natural oil finish. Seats 10-12. Sustainably sourced Indonesian teak, heavy-duty brass hardware. Ideal for large entertaining areas and hospitality.

items.name: Teak Dining Chair
items.description: Grade A teak dining chair with slatted seat and back. Stacks 4 high. Dimensions: 55W x 60D x 88H cm. Sold individually. Cushion sold separately.

items.name: Aluminium Lounge Sofa 2-Seater
items.description: Powder-coated marine-grade aluminium lounge sofa, 2-seater. Frame: matte charcoal. Includes Sunbrella® cushions in stone linen. Dimensions: 165W x 85D x 70H cm. UV, rust, and saltwater resistant.

items.name: Aluminium Lounge Sofa 3-Seater
items.description: Powder-coated marine-grade aluminium lounge sofa, 3-seater. Frame: matte charcoal. Includes Sunbrella® cushions in stone linen. Dimensions: 230W x 85D x 70H cm. UV, rust, and saltwater resistant.

items.name: Wicker Daybed with Canopy
items.description: All-weather resin wicker daybed with retractable fabric canopy. Aluminium frame, Sunbrella® mattress and bolster cushions. Dimensions: 210W x 130D x 155H cm (canopy extended). Suitable for pool areas and terraces.

items.name: Sun Lounger Aluminium Flat
items.description: Adjustable aluminium sun lounger with 5-position backrest. Marine-grade powder coat finish in bone white. Includes Sunbrella® cushion. Dimensions: 200W x 70D x 35H cm (flat). Stackable.

items.name: Cantilever Umbrella 4m
items.description: 4m diameter cantilever market umbrella. Marine-grade aluminium pole and ribs. Sunbrella® canopy in sand. 360° rotation, tilt mechanism. Includes weighted base. Wind rating: up to 35 km/h.

items.name: Teak Outdoor Side Table Round
items.description: Solid grade A teak round side table. Dimensions: 50cm diameter x 55H cm. Natural oil finish. Suitable for use alongside sun loungers and lounge sofas. Lightweight and easy to move.

items.name: Teak Outdoor Bar Cabinet
items.description: Freestanding teak outdoor bar cabinet with stainless steel hardware. Two hinged doors, interior shelving, and pull-out prep surface. Dimensions: 120W x 55D x 110H cm. Teak oil finish. Ideal for outdoor kitchens and entertainment areas.
